audit.why: Wrong ability slot for Devour would mislead a player about which cooldown to track, and the missing digit fails the cooldown-sequencing defect the packet flagged.
audit.corrected: Rewrote with Q(15s)/W(11s) real cooldowns and corrected Devour to R.
